Retains ティセイア王国 and its collapse as major setting/event.
Retains 杖の一族 as lineage/concept and political target.

Retains ベル as 舌のないベル despite missing first-class objects schema.

No populated CANONICAL_ENTITY_MAP, so baby/testifier identity cannot be linked to later canon.
No explicit keeper_of/artifact ownership relation type.

Dense prologue events are compressed into four events and may lose priority tiers.
私 appears under characters because schema lacks better narrator/witness candidate handling.
false_positive_or_noise_risks: canonical_candidate 王者の杖 for 赤子 is plausible but should remain review-only.
王 and 王妃 appear as title-like character entries with no names and need review.
〈災厄〉 could be actual threat or official narrative artifact.
downstream_risks: ベル may be mapped as concept instead of durable object.
Pronoun narrator 私 could become a noisy entity if downstream ignores naming_quality/needs_review.
赤子 could be over-promoted as 王者の杖 without later evidence/canonical map.
Relations may lose important narrative semantics before review queue.
recommended_next_fixes: Add objects/artifacts array to chapter extraction schema and downstream mapper.
Add explicit empty canonical map mode for strong local candidates without canon approval.
Expand relation taxonomy or allow subtype/details for guardian/rescuer/keeper/usurper/survivor_of.
Raise or tier event cap for dense chapters.
Run global normalization manually/with captured ChatGPT response, then recapture chapter prompt with populated canonical map.
